import 'dart:io';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/tree_sitter_language_pack.dart';
import 'package:tree_sitter_language_pack/src/tree_sitter_language_pack_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final config = await createProcessConfigFromJson(json: '{"language":"java"}');
    final result = await TreeSitterLanguagePackBridge.process('package com.example.widget;\n\npublic class Widget {\n    public String name() { return "w"; }\n}\n', config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.language);
    stdout.writeln(result.structure);
    stdout.writeln(result.structure[0].kind);
    stdout.writeln(result.metrics.errorCount);

    RustLib.dispose();
